name: traces_operation_error_burst
title: Error burst on an operation
description: One server or consumer operation (endpoint or queue handler) of a service had 20 or more spans with status ERROR in the last 10 minutes, and those errors were at least 5% of its spans. The ratio floor keeps a busy endpoint with a small, steady error share from firing. Uses span status, so it also covers non-HTTP services. Needs OpenTelemetry traces in the traces stream named default.

query_condition.sql: SELECT service_name, operation_name, SUM(CASE WHEN span_status = 'ERROR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS errors, COUNT(*) AS spans, SUM(CASE WHEN span_status = 'ERROR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS error_pct FROM "default" WHERE span_kind IN ('2', '5') GROUP BY service_name, operation_name HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN span_status = 'ERROR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 20 AND SUM(CASE WHEN span_status = 'ERROR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) >= 5
